verdict.rationale: Helicone explicitly advertises a Playground for rapid prompt/session/trace iteration and separate docs on testing/deploying prompt changes instantly and referencing prompt IDs live in the AI Gateway, supporting real-model iteration. However, no evidence details variable/template support within the playground or independent hands-on confirmation of the playground UX. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variable/templating support in the playground, and independent user reviews of the playground experience specifically.
